cards.ex: I often look back on my college days with fondness.
cards.exUz: Men ko'pincha kollej davrlarimni mehr bilan eslayman.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi voqealarni eslash va ular haqida fikr bildirish.

cards.ex: We've come up against some unexpected problems with the new software.
cards.exUz: Yangi dasturiy ta'minot bilan ba'zi kutilmagan muammolarga duch keldik.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchilik yoki muammoga duch kelmoq.

cards.ex: I need to check in with my boss before making a decision.
cards.exUz: Qaror qabul qilishdan oldin boshlig'im bilan bog'lanib turishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kim bilandir muntazam ravishda bog'lanib turish, xabar olish.

cards.ex: Let's get on with the meeting; we're already late.
cards.exUz: Keling, yig'ilishni davom ettiramiz; biz allaqachon kechikdik.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishni davom ettirish, ayniqsa to'xtashdan keyin.

cards.ex: I didn't really agree, but I decided to go along with it.
cards.exUz: Men unchalik rozi bo'lmadim, lekin bunga qo'shilishga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir fikri yoki rejasi bilan rozi bo'lish.

cards.ex: You can't put those old houses up against these modern ones.
cards.exUz: Siz bu eski uylarni zamonaviylarga qarshi qo'ya olmaysiz.
cards.uzDef: Ikki narsani solishtirish uchun bir-biriga qarshi qo'yish.

cards.ex: You should keep away from sugary drinks.
cards.exUz: Siz shakarli ichimliklardan uzoqroq turishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir yoki kimdandir uzoq turish.

cards.ex: Look out for ice on the roads tonight.
cards.exUz: Bugun kechqurun yo'llarda muz bo'lishidan ehtiyot bo'ling.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yomon bo'lishi mumkinligidan ogoh bo'lish.

cards.ex: I had to stand in for my colleague while she was on vacation.
cards.exUz: Men hamkasbim ta'tilda bo'lganida uning o'rniga ishlashim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir o'rniga vaqtinchalik ishlash.

cards.ex: He tried to get out of doing the dishes.
cards.exUz: U idishlarni yuvishdan qochishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishdan qochish, o'zini olib qochish.

cards.ex: It took him a while to catch on to the new rules.
cards.exUz: U yangi qoidalarni tushunib yetishi uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yangi narsani tushunish, ilg'ab olish.

cards.ex: Our plans to go to Italy fell through with the pandemic.
cards.exUz: Bizning Italiyaga borish rejamiz pandemiya tufayli muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi.
cards.uzDef: Bajarolmaslik, muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrash

cards.ex: I finally gave in to his demands.
cards.exUz: Men nihoyat uning talablariga taslim bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishga qarshilik qilgandan keyin taslim bo'lish.

cards.ex: The new policy ties in with our environmental goals.
cards.exUz: Yangi siyosat bizning ekologik maqsadlarimizga bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir bilan bog'liq yoki aloqador bo'lish.

cards.ex: She's planning to get back at him for what he did.
cards.exUz: U qilgan ishi uchun undan qasos olishni rejalashtirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kimdandir o'ch olish, qasos qaytarish.

cards.ex: Can you look in on my grandmother while I'm away?
cards.exUz: Men yo'qligimda buvimdan xabar olib tura olasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir holidan xabar olish, yo'qlab kelish.

cards.ex: Don't take your anger out on me; it's not my fault.
cards.exUz: Mendan jahlingizni chiqarmang; bu mening aybim emas.
cards.uzDef: Kimdandir yoki nimadandir alamingni chiqarish.

cards.ex: I hate it when people talk down to me.
cards.exUz: Odamlar menga past nazar bilan gaplashganda yomon ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Kim bilandir o'zini undan ustun tutib gaplashish.

cards.ex: In the end, it all comes down to money.
cards.exUz: Oxir-oqibat, hammasi pulga bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy mohiyatga kelib taqalmoq, yakuniy natija.

cards.ex: I was just playing around with the settings on my camera.
cards.exUz: Men shunchaki kameramdagi sozlamalar bilan o'ynayotgan edim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir bilan tajriba o'tkazish, sinab ko'rish.

cards.ex: Someone made off with my bike last night.
cards.exUz: Kecha kechqurun kimdir mening velosipedimni o'g'irlab qochib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir o'g'irlab qochib ketmoq.

cards.ex: She quickly sized up the competition.
cards.exUz: U tezda raqobatni baholadi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir yoki nimaningdir hajmi, kuchi yoki qobiliyatini baholash.

cards.ex: I like to check up on my investments regularly.
cards.exUz: Men investitsiyalarimni muntazam ravishda tekshirib turishni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir holatini yoki nimanidir tekshirib turish.

cards.ex: They cooked up with a plan to cheat the system.
cards.exUz: Ular tizimni aldash uchun reja uydirishdi.
cards.uzDef: Aldash maqsadida biror narsani uydirmoq.

cards.ex: The teacher dished out assignments to the class.
cards.exUz: O'qituvchi sinfga topshiriqlarni tarqatdi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p miqdorda nimadir tarqatish.

cards.ex: Don't wait up for me; I'll be late.
cards.exUz: Meni kutib o'tirmang; kech qolaman.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir kelishini kutib o'tirish.

cards.ex: He got mixed up with the wrong crowd.
cards.exUz: U noto'g'ri odamlarga aralashib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon odamlar yoki vaziyatlarga aralashib qolish.

cards.ex: I'm going to sign up for a yoga class.
cards.exUz: Men yoga darsiga ro'yxatdan o'tmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Kurs, tadbir yoki faoliyatga ro'yxatdan o'tish.

cards.ex: I needed to get away from the city for a while.
cards.exUz: Men bir muddat shahardan uzoqlashishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir yoki kimdandir qochish, chetlanish.

cards.ex: I've fallen behind with my rent payments.
cards.exUz: Men ijara to'lovlaridan ortda qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Ish yoki majburiyatlarda vaqtidan ortda qolish.
